MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper feels useful because measuring hose and fitting diameters would help me choose clamps that fit my repair jobs.",
    "The repair epoxies connect naturally with my tape and vinyl cement purchases because they offer another way to fix damaged items. I would choose the J-B Weld this time rather than buy both."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Polishing wheels, cutting wheels and feeler gauges serve specific tasks I have not shown a need for; doing repairs does not mean I currently need polishing, metal cutting or clearance measurements.",
    "The connector kit interests me, but 1080 pieces feels excessive when I already have an assortment. A thousand small gloves also feels unsuitable without knowing whether the size fits.",
    "Fluorescent green gaffer tape does not address the same need as my black repair tapes; I have no current reason to want bright marking or temporary fastening."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop accessory, even when it requires a different task or a tool I may not own.",
    "A familiar tape brand or another large supply assortment is not enough to make something useful to me now; the material, purpose and quantity matter."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My hose clamps make tools that help measure and fit hoses especially relevant, while unrelated precision tools need a clearer purpose.",
    "I distinguish between something that fits my repair interests and something I would choose today: sealant needs a specific sealing job, and another connector assortment needs a reason beyond what I already have.",
    "Similar adhesives can be alternatives for the same purchase rather than separate needs, so liking both epoxies does not mean I want both now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests, but sometimes overlook the specific job, suitable quantity and supplies I already have."
}
